get_distance_function_from_name: get a distance function by name such as euclidian, cosine, kl, or kl_symmetric
get_kl_distance_batch: compute the KL divergence distance between two batched sequence tensors with epsilon smoothing
get_cosine_distance_batch: compute the cosine distance between two normalized batched sequence tensors
get_theta_group_dtw: compute the ABX theta score using DTW distances between groups a, b, and x
get_abx_scores_dtw_on_group: compute ABX scores across all groups in an iterator using DTW and return a sparse tensor
